name: Image to Image
description: Image to Image is an overview page: browse 21 featured image editing models and example edits, then open Edit Studio to edit a photo or Image Studio to restyle one with a prompt.
shortDescription: Browse image editing models and examples, then edit in Edit Studio or Image Studio.
fullDescription: Image to Image (#/image-to-image) is a starting page, not an editor. It has a 'Ready to Transform?' section with 'Get Started Free', four 'Powerful Image Editing' highlight cards, an 'Available Models' grid ('21 featured models out of 92 image-to-image models'), five 'Example Transformations' cards, and a 'Start Editing Now' section with 'Start Editing' and '🎯 GTM Boost'. There is no upload, prompt box or Generate button here. 'Get Started Free' and 'Start Editing' open Edit Studio (#/edit), the photo editing tools. A model card, an example card and GTM Boost's Apply open Image Studio (#/image) instead: an example or GTM Boost prompt is placed in Image Studio's prompt box (and then cleared, so it does not reappear later), and a clicked model is selected only when Image Studio has a model with that exact name. Image Studio opens in text-to-image and switches to image-to-image models when you add a reference image.
bestFor: Users who want to see what kinds of image edits and models are available before opening Edit Studio or Image Studio.
whenToUse: You want an overview of image editing models (Nano Banana Edit, Flux Kontext, GPT Image Edit, Seededit and more).
You want ideas for transformations (watercolor, film noir, cyberpunk...) carried into Image Studio's prompt box.
You want a quick link into Edit Studio.
whenToUseAnother: Use Edit Studio (#/edit) directly to upload a photo and run a tool.
Use Image Studio (#/image) directly for prompt-based image-to-image: add a reference image and it switches to image-to-image models.
Use Text to Image (#/text-to-image) when you have no photo and want to start from words.
keyFeatures: 'Get Started Free' and 'Start Editing' buttons that open Edit Studio.
'Available Models' grid of 21 featured editing models and AI tools; a click opens Image Studio.
'Example Transformations' with 'Try this →' that put the prompt into Image Studio.
'🎯 GTM Boost' prompt helper that opens Image Studio with the prompt filled in.

featureExplanations.explanation: Four information cards: 'Smart Transformations', '92 Models', 'Style Transfer' and 'Professional Tools' ('Background removal, face swap, skin enhancement & more'). They are not buttons.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Summary of the kinds of edits available.
featureExplanations.restrictions: '92 Models' is the number of image-to-image models in Image Studio; the page grid shows 21 featured ones.

featureExplanations.explanation: A grid of 21 cards ('21 featured models out of 92 image-to-image models'): editing models (Nano Banana Edit, Flux Kontext Dev/Pro/Max I2I, Flux Redux, Flux Pulid, GPT-4o Edit, GPT Image 1.5 Edit, Midjourney v7 I2I, Seededit v3, Bytedance Seedream Edit, Qwen Image Edit, Wan Image Edit, Ideogram Character) and AI tools (AI Background Remover, AI Face Swap, AI Dress Change, AI Skin Enhancer, AI Product Shot). Clicking a card opens Image Studio (#/image).
featureExplanations.whyToUse: See which editing models and tools exist.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Image Studio selects the clicked model only if its starting (text-to-image) list has a model with that exact name; of these cards only Flux Redux and Flux Pulid match. For the others Image Studio opens on your last-used (or default) model. Add a reference image to switch to image-to-image models and pick the editing model there, or use the matching Edit Studio tool (Remove Background, Face Swap, Change Dress, Enhance Skin, Product Shot).

featureExplanations.explanation: Five example cards with a model badge and 'Try this →' (for example 'Convert to watercolor painting style with soft colors' with Nano Banana Edit). Clicking the card or 'Try this →' opens Image Studio with the example text in the prompt box.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Ideas for what to write when you edit.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Only the Flux Redux example's model is selected in Image Studio; the other badges (Nano Banana Edit, GPT Image 1.5 Edit, Midjourney v7 I2I, Seededit v3) have no exact match there. No image is attached: add your photo as a reference image in Image Studio before generating.

featureExplanations.explanation: In 'Start Editing Now' ('Upload an image and let AI transform it'), 'Start Editing' opens Edit Studio, where you upload your image.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Open the editor after reading the page.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: None here; the upload happens in Edit Studio.
featureExplanations.restrictions: No upload on this page. Edit Studio opens with no tool chosen.

featureExplanations.explanation: The '🎯 GTM Boost' button opens the GTM Boost window ('🎯 GTM Boost · Image Edit'). You write your idea, pick an angle, audience and goal, and click the Boost button to get a conversion-focused prompt. 'Apply' closes the window and opens Image Studio with that prompt already in the prompt box; add a reference image there to edit a photo with it.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Turn a rough marketing idea into a ready-to-use prompt before you start.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: An idea in step 1 (otherwise the window says 'Add your ... idea first.').
featureExplanations.restrictions: Without an OpenAI key the window shows 'Add your OpenAI key for AI-written results. Until then GTM Boost uses a built-in template.' The prompt goes to Image Studio, not Edit Studio.

howToUse: 1. Open Image to Image (#/image-to-image). 2. Browse 'Available Models' and 'Example Transformations' for ideas. 3. To use an Edit Studio tool, click 'Get Started Free' or 'Start Editing': Edit Studio (#/edit) opens; choose a tool, upload your image and run it. 4. To restyle a photo with a prompt, click an example (or a model card, or GTM Boost and Apply): Image Studio (#/image) opens with the prompt filled in. 5. In Image Studio add your photo as a reference image, check the model and click Generate.

faqs.question: Can I generate directly on this page?
faqs.answer: No. This page has no prompt box, upload, ratio or Generate button. 'Get Started Free' and 'Start Editing' open Edit Studio (#/edit); model cards, examples and GTM Boost open Image Studio (#/image).

faqs.question: Where can I do prompt-based image-to-image with a reference photo?
faqs.answer: In Image Studio (#/image): add a reference image and it switches to image-to-image models. The example cards here open it with the prompt filled in.

faqs.question: Will an example prompt show up again later in another studio?
faqs.answer: No. Image Studio reads the prompt once and clears it.

glossary.Prompt: The text you write to tell the AI what to make.
glossary.Model: The AI engine that makes the result; each one has its own style and options.
glossary.Prefill: When this page passes a prompt or model to the studio so it is already filled in when the studio opens.
glossary.GTM Boost: A helper window that rewrites your idea as a marketing-focused prompt (GTM = go-to-market).
glossary.Image-to-image: Making a new or changed image starting from a photo you supply.
